text.p: Swiss insurance group Baloise Holding said business in early 1997 had been good and if the current trends held it expected satisfactory full-year results.
The company is also maintaining its 1998 profit goal of 240 million Swiss francs, chief executive Rolf Schaeuble said in the text of remarks prepared for a news conference.

In addition, financial officer Carl Meyer said the dividend omission for the 1996/97 fiscal year was a one-off event and that he expected the company to return to an upward trend with regard to dividend payments.
The company paid a dividend of 47 Swiss francs per share on 1995 results.
But in April Baloise said it would it would pay back capital of 80 Swiss francs per share instead of a dividend on 1996 results.
The company had 1996 net earnings of 191 million Swiss francs. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
